depiction.primary_object: two curved arrows forming a vertical counterclockwise cycle
depiction.composition: symmetrical pair of opposing semicircular arrows, front view

ambiguity: Nearly identical to dozens of other refresh, reload, sync, rotate, and flip-camera icons that differ only in arrow orientation or clockwise vs counterclockwise direction.

renew a recurring subscription or license
convert currency or transfer between accounts
replace worn consumables on a cycle

reasoning: Shows two curved arrows forming a loop, the universal glyph for sync, refresh, swap, or cycle. In a to-do list it fits tasks specifically about data synchronization, item exchanges, or physical rotation, though most 'update' or 'renew' tasks are better served by an icon of the object being updated. It is easily confused with other clockwise/counterclockwise reload and rotate icons.
